title: Strategy leaderboard — signal block and staking block scored separately

source.label: Research lab (code/pipeline_lab.py) over fingerprinted nflverse/nfldata; results feed 2026 official
source.note: No official NFL source publishes betting prices (F-06); price-derived numbers are third-party research.

columns: ROI after the recorded luck rule removes lucky wins
ROI under recorded stake sizing — blank until stakes exist

rows.name: Wind - under

signal.luck_rule: wins reaching 28-0 in 2026, cover after 28-0, or win with losing net yards and turnover margin <= 0 are luck and excluded
signal.flats_note: Every signal metric is flat-stake (1 unit per settled signal); staking is scored separately below.

staking.note: No strategy is live and none has ever been staked under recorded stake sizing; staking metrics stay blank until real stakes exist. A lucky staking run can never mask a bad signal because the two blocks are scored independently.

gates.name: Sample sufficiency
gates.detail: Bets settled in the out-of-sample window.

gates.name: Out-of-sample integrity
gates.value: first OOS season 2015; 0 duplicate bet ids
gates.threshold: no duplicate bets; parameters chosen from earlier seasons only
gates.detail: Parameters are re-selected each season from games that finished before it.

gates.name: Statistical significance
gates.threshold: CI lower bound > 0 and permutation p <= 0.05
gates.detail: Bootstrap (10,000 resamples) and a 10,000-draw permutation test on profit per bet.

gates.name: Economic significance
gates.threshold: >= 2.0% per unit staked
gates.detail: Unit stakes; the book price in the source data is used, -115 where no price is published.

gates.name: Beats naive baselines
gates.threshold: ROI above every naive baseline
gates.detail: Baseline ROI on the same window: always_under +1.87%, always_over -1.87%, always_favourite -2.70%, always_underdog -31.85%

gates.name: Luck robustness
gates.threshold: clean ROI > 0 and >= 40% of full-sample ROI
gates.detail: ROI +11.53% full sample vs +13.04% after removing one-score games (margin <= 8) and blowouts (margin >= 25); 156 games retained.

gates.name: Parameter stability
gates.detail: Neighbouring parameter values on the same out-of-sample window - min_wind=10.0: +12.93%; min_wind=14.0: +8.64%

gates.name: Non-redundancy
gates.detail: No other strategy has cleared the gates yet, so redundancy cannot be measured; the gate is treated as satisfied until a peer qualifies.

flags: research dataset on fingerprinted mirror inputs (not official prices)
